screens.whyToday: Your feed decided what you are before you opened it this morning. This week we start somewhere else.

screens.prompt: Which one lands closest to today's verse?

screens.source: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

points.headline: Fearfully means awe, not scary
points.body: The Hebrew pala means set apart, distinguished. You weren't built generic. You were built specific on purpose.

points.headline: Your soul already knows
points.body: The end of the verse says your soul knows this right well. That means some part of you already senses this before the feed can touch it.

points.headline: Made is in the past tense
points.body: You're not a draft. Not a beta version. Fearfully made is already complete. Your becoming is real, but the made is finished.
